# Uruu OS

> All-in-one business management platform for pharmacies, retail shops, internet cafés, and printing & branding businesses in Zambia: point of sale, inventory, pharmacy dispensing, café & WiFi sessions, and printing orders.

Uruu OS is a multi-tenant SaaS product. Each business (tenant) gets its own workspace with point-of-sale, inventory, and business-type-specific modules (pharmacy dispensing, café/WiFi session billing, printing order management). New businesses can start a free 7-day trial with no credit card required.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://uruu.enterprises/): product overview, feature breakdown by business type, and pricing.
- [Start a free trial](https://uruu.enterprises/signup): self-service signup.
